title: Ask MAIN to use claude (Claude Code on Opus) for a hard task
persona: A developer who saves the claude agent for the hard parts. Short phone messages; refers to it simply as 'claude'.
goals: Have the claude agent (not the default builder) write a python module in a folder named intervals that merges overlapping time intervals and computes the total covered duration, with thorough pytest tests including edge cases.
Then, as a follow-up to the same claude session, ask it to add a function that returns the gaps between intervals.
Get confirmation that all tests pass.
script: Ask main to give the intervals job to claude, in your own short words.
Wait for main to come back with the result.
Send the gaps follow-up (it should go to the same claude session).
Ask whether all tests pass, then finish.

checks.name: intervals tests pass
checks.cmd: cd intervals && python3 -m pytest -q >/tmp/pytest.$$.out 2>&1 && echo PYTEST-OK || tail -5 /tmp/pytest.$$.out

checks.name: a claude session did the work
follow-up reused the session (<=1 under main)
